description: The Windows window pages that the bundled engine serves on 127.0.0.1 may call Writer's own shell commands (report the window title and state, open a tab dragged off the title bar in a window of its own, keep the shared settings, show the open and Save dialogs, list and open recent files, snap their window to a layout zone, restart after a language change, ask about and set the default app, check for updates, hand a PDF to another viewer) and drive their own frameless window from the design's title bar (drag, double-click to maximize, minimize, maximize, close). Nothing else: no file system, shell or other windows.
